headlines.title: Honeywell Teams up With NVIDIA, Dell To Chase Massive Oil Refinery Savings
headlines.summary: Honeywell International, Inc. (NASDAQ:HON) on Monday announced that it launched the Forge Plant Cognition, an industrial AI platform developed with NVIDIA Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Dell Technologies Inc (NYSE:DELL). The platform will debut at Dangote Petroleum Refinery in Lekki, Nigeria, where Honeywell estimates it could generate more than $60 million in gross annual operational benefits at full capacity.

headlines.title: Honeywell Deploys Industrial AI Platform at Dangote Refinery in Nigeria
headlines.summary: Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ:HON) has launched Forge Plant Cognition, an artificial intelligence platform designed for industrial operations, with its first deployment at Dangote’s petroleum refinery in Lekki, Nigeria. The platform combines Honeywell’s industrial technology with AI and accelerated computing capabilities from NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) and infrastructure supplied by Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL).

headlines.title: Honeywell Technologies Launches Forge Plant Cognition with Dangote, Built with NVIDIA AI and Dell Technologies Capabilities
headlines.summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., October 26, 2026--Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) has announced the launch of Forge Plant Cognition, an industrial AI platform built with NVIDIA AI and accelerated computing capabilities, and Dell Technologies’ AI infrastructure. The platform is designed to help refining, petrochemical and Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) operators generate greater value from their existing assets and transform plant operations.

headlines.title: Honeywell Technologies CEO Says Business Is Growing Faster Than Expected
headlines.summary: Honeywell International Inc. stock traded lower in premarket trading Thursday after the company reported mixed third-quarter results, with adjusted earnings beating Wall Street expectations while revenue fell short of estimates.

description: Honeywell International Inc. engages in the industrial automation, building automation, and energy and sustainability solutions businesses in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The Industrial Automation segment provides automation control and instrumentation products and services; smart energy products; sensing technologies, including custom-engineered sensors and related services; gas detection technologies and personal protective equipment; and system design automation equipment, as well as software and analytics for manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment operations. The Building Automation segment provides software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and system upgrade services. The Energy and Sustainability Solutions segment, through its UOP business, delivers licensed process technology, equipment, engineering, catalysts, adsorbents, and services for refining, petrochemicals, low-carbon energy, gas and LNG, and industrial solutions, as well as connectivity, data integration, and software solutions. The company also offers Forge Cognition, a self-contained agentic AI and simulation platform for facility operations. The company was formerly known as AlliedSignal, Inc. Honeywell International Inc. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
